changes: Comparison-only explicit alphabetic correction matching recognizes Chinese commas and preserves adjacent Chinese prefixes and independent later mentions. Accented, Cyrillic and Greek name corrections remain supported.
Same-unit Chinese duration corrections separated by explicit 不对/不對 markers can use their final wording; unresolved alternatives and different units are not repaired.
Only a sentence-introducing One more thing: marker (optionally Actually,) can be excluded from numerical comparison. Actual quantities remain protected.

Light candidates rejected for a missing unique content word may request semantic review only for a punctuation-delimited I mean outside literal spans, at most 12 token edits and at most min(selected threshold,0.22) edit ratio, after protected facts and the full ending pass. Literal and mixed-language checks also remain mandatory.

Light semantic review uses the existing public verifier with an additional restraint constraint. It may remove explicit false starts and ordinary disfluencies, repair grammar/punctuation and format stated lists; unrelated paraphrase/reordered ideas/missing details fail.
Semantic FAIL keeps the exact original quietly; verifier errors retain raw with recovery; cancellation delivers no result. Exact quoted/code literals remain protected.

Final Chinese duration quantities and units are checked independently of edit distance, preserving repeated independent mentions and rejecting changed final numerals even at the loose threshold. Traditional/Simplified unit spelling is normalized for comparison.
limits: Offline fixtures test routing and safety decisions with injected responses, not model accuracy. The unchanged 47-case provider suite is recorded in final-results.json; the separate 24-case preference rerun is under preference-review. No microphone, recording, clipboard or insertion claim.
